PZZ700-162030-
1252 AM PDT Fri Oct 16 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1036 mb high was located over eastern Oregon and
Tropical Storm Simon was located approximately 1050 miles south-
southeast of San Diego. Offshore flow will prevail and strengthen
today into tomorrow. Isolated easterly gusts could exceed 20 
knots later this evening into early Saturday. Onshore northwest 
flow returns Saturday afternoon and evening, which will alternate 
with weak offshore flow during the nights and mornings through 
Monday. Onshore flow will continue to increase from there with 
strengthening winds out of the west-southwest due to an 
approaching area of low pressure towards the middle of next week.

$$
